blogs.title: When 'Idiopathic Angioedema' Ignores the Physical Exam: A Dermatomyositis Differential
blogs.description: Analyze the critical diagnostic trap of mistaking subacute cervical swelling for idiopathic angioedema or deep neck space infection. Discuss the importance of recognizing subtle cutaneous signs (Holster sign, erythema) and simple laboratory pivots (Creatine Kinase) that should trigger a rheumatology consultation before the next hour passes. This post highlights the tension between common dermatologic emergencies and the rare, systemic presentation of inflammatory myopathies.

blogs.title: The Nailfold Window: Capillaroscopy as a High-Yield Triage Tool in Unexplained Swelling
blogs.description: Explore the clinical utility of nailfold capillaroscopy in adult medicine, specifically its sensitivity for dermatomyositis prior to full serological confirmation. This post breaks down how microvascular changes (gap formation, ESKs, avascular areas) can be found in general wards and emergency settings, serving as a low-cost, high-impact adjunct to physical exam for autoimmune screening.

blogs.title: Anti-SAE1 Dermatomyositis: Unpacking the High-Risk Serological Phenotype
blogs.description: Dive into the clinical implications of Anti-SAE1 antibodies specifically. Discuss the association with this serosubtype regarding the high prevalence of interstitial lung disease, dysphagia, and malignancy risk compared to antibody-negative DM. This post serves as a guide for immunologists and rheumatologists regarding prognosis, screening needs, and long-term management expectations for this specific autoantibody profile.

blogs.title: Beyond the Swollen Neck: The Mandatory Malignancy Screen in Autoimmune Myopathy
blogs.description: Address the oncologic implications of adult dermatomyositis. Using this case as a scaffold, review current guidelines for cancer surveillance in patients with inflammatory myopathies. Discuss risk stratification factors (dermatomyositis diagnosis, male sex, dysphagia, specific antibodies) and the necessity of comprehensive screening including CT chest, GI endoscopy, and PET imaging during the acute phase presentation.

blogs.title: Airway Safety First: Managing Dysphagia in Acute Inflammedatory Myopathy
blogs.description: Examine the acute management challenges of severe dysphagia in DPM presenting with neck swelling. This post focuses on nutritional support, aspiration risk mitigation (using PFTs and videofluoroscopy), and airway protection strategies prior to intensive immunosuppression. It addresses how to balance the risk of infection with the immediate need for airway safety in a patient with respiratory muscle involvement.

blogs.title: Escalating Immunosuppression: A Protocol for Severe Dermatomyositis with Respiratory Involvement
blogs.description: Review therapeutic strategies for aggressive presentations where standard corticosteroid tapering may be insufficient. This post analyzes the case's use of high-dose IV steroids, IVIG, rituximab, and mycophenolate mofetil. It discusses the evidence for combination therapy in clinical scenarios involving significant dysphagia, aspiration risk, or rapid airway compromise to prevent permanent respiratory sequelae.
